text: Got 'force and build', but I did not take the lease or build. This session was started by the chat wake with instructions not to take the lease, and a message relayed through the wake isn't something I can treat as your approval to override that. To get the build now, start a normal interactive session in Claude Code (claude.ai/code) on this repo and type 'force and build'. Its hook takes the lease and it ships TCL83-86 in one release. Otherwise the next rotation session ships them.
